source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: OOB counterpart of unresolved IB Delete SDR; Clear SDR is not a substitute.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Framework lacks an approved disposable target and reconstructable recovery.
historical_reviews.history: IB Delete SDR remains BLOCKED pending record/dependency/recovery contract.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Irreversible identity and recovery ambiguity are core blockers.

original_test_intent: Delete exactly one approved SDR record and prove no unrelated sensor, threshold or repository data changes.
original_method: Undefined until exact record/dependencies, reservation, pre-export, post-diff and restore/rebuild are approved.
manual_activity: Owner/vendor selects a safely removable record and defines reconstruction and monitoring recovery.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly non-executable; command number cannot identify a safely disposable record.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: None until exact target, no-collateral oracle and independently validated restore/rebuild exist.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: After resolution export/hash repository, reserve, delete one exact ID, compare all records/sensors, then rebuild/restore under the approved contract.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Safety framework only; no deletion target is invented.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Clear SDR or hiding a sensor does not validate one-record delete.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Removing a dependent SDR can disable or misdecode platform monitoring with no trivial undo.

project_override_considerations: A vendor API is equivalent only with exact record identity, collateral comparison and rebuild proof.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Mutation title conflicts with wholly TBD body and evidence-clearing boilerplate; no target or oracle exists.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Target identity, dependency impact and recovery define the operation and remain unknown.

review_improvement: Prevents an irreversible guessed delete and keeps OOB aligned with the existing IB pending decision.
independent_technical_reasoning: An SDR record may be referenced by sensor numbers, entities, thresholds and monitoring consumers. Without a dependency map and rebuild method, exact-ID deletion can still corrupt platform telemetry, so user confirmation alone is insufficient.
